name: MongoDB Community Edition

evidence.nosql: C02: primary type is self-hosted BSON document database with native document queries
evidence.vector: D08: self-managed mongot runs Search and Vector Search; V01: HNSW and quantization options

line: Self-hosted document database with GridFS and vector search.

free.text: Free SSPL-1.0; no hosted quota or idle rule; you run and retain the data

cells.metered: Community software $0; hardware and operations extra

sql.math: $0 software fee. Host size, search resources, disks, backups, traffic and embeddings are not priced.
The software stays $0. Kept host, data, backups and operations depend on your infrastructure provider.

files.math: $0 software fee. 100 GB of file storage needs database hosts with known prices, chunk I/O, backups and delivery infrastructure.

jobs.math: Community Server does not include managed job workers
